description: Modules excluded from the default chain and default coverage denominator because the component is absent from the six mainstream profiles. Explicit runs remain possible with --profile/--collect/--probe. A module.json default_enabled=false always wins; this file covers modules owned by parallel workstreams.

modules.federated-learning-audit: Requires an NVFlare/Flower/FATE controller; absent from all six profiles.
modules.model-watermark-backdoor-audit: Requires a watermark/acceptance service; absent from all six profiles.
modules.post-quantum-tls-audit: Requires a PQ TLS endpoint; absent from all six profiles.
modules.wasm-runtime-audit: Requires a WASM RuntimeClass/shim; absent from all six profiles.
